title: arctotheca tristis
intro: Arctotheca tristis, commonly known as the "Cape daisy", is a perennial succulent plant species native to South Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the Cape daisy include wound healing, pain relief, and the reduction of inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Arctotheca tristis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
